boundaries: Original r54 again reproduces a trusted cancellable noncomposing atomic20MiB+1 input stall after beforeinput. Profiler stop and readonly renderer observation time out too; no claim to know the browser internal C++/JS call stack. Candidate interception passes the same real normal packaged App input; no private Store/model writes in the A driver.

Small <=65536 units, paste/null data/noncancelable/already-handled/readonly events retain old path. Composition guard checks public EditorView.compositionStarted so even pre-first-composition-change events are not intercepted; event.isComposing separately guarded. U uses synthetic events/real CodeMirror; no physical system IME claim.

Actual one10MiB input writes complete expected bytes through genuine checkpoint/save;10MiB+1 and20MiB+1 retain full model/hash and respectively refuse10/20MiB. No new formal case IDs counted.

Performance values are input command elapsed for fixed repetitive Unicode fixtures, not complete UI latency/memory or all-size guarantees. Real clipboard paste is unchanged and not tested; physical IME/shortcut-scope/complete large-text visual and resource budgets remain separate cases. Old r2/r3 Mod-z cleanup issue not declared fixed.

First candidate test assumed EditorView.composing at compositionstart; installed primary source shows compositionStarted covers before first document change. Test and guard corrected, synthetic active composition preserved. First typecheck test fixture type referenced optional EditorStateConfig; corrected type Extension. Both failures retained.

First package build failed sandbox codesign verification of pinned LibreOffice although inventory matched. Read-only normal-permission verification of both original cache and r54 vendor App passed unchanged; authorized retry preserves original verification and all six fresh native checks. No signature bypass/resource rewrite/public release.
